documents.doc-cz-kpr-2026-09-29-kpr-5080-2026: The Office of the President acknowledged two further submissions received on 22 September 2026. It stated that neither the President nor any representative of the Office would attend the public hearings on the reopening applications at Prostějov District Court on 12 and 13 October 2026. Referring to its letter of 2 September 2026, it said that the President would reconsider the repeated pardon request only after a longer interval and, above all, if new material facts relevant to revising his previous refusals emerged. No date for reconsideration could be specified in advance; the applicant would be notified promptly when a decision was made. The letter itself does not grant a pardon or announce a new decision on its merits.
